name: Stepping Stones
summary: At a backcountry camp in the Barrens, a weathered note points toward Stepping Stones, a mountain refuge near Desolace. It says two couriers made deliveries for the New Plague, and calls their sudden ends simple apothecary accidents.

sections.title: A Note in the Wilds
sections.body: A torn message hangs from a wooden plank at a backcountry camp in the Barrens. Mercenaries, cutthroats, and drifters stop at such camps for brief shelter, far from the eyes of the Crossroads or Ratchet. Among the ordinary signs of the wilds, the note gives you reason to look beyond the camp toward the mountains.

sections.title: Whispers of the New Plague
sections.body: The anonymous writer says two agents made deliveries for the New Plague, then calls their sudden ends simple apothecary accidents. The note invites you to meet at a mountain refuge between the Barrens and Desolace, where you can discuss the matter in safety.

faq.q: What is the note found in Stepping Stones talking about?
faq.answer: The note says two couriers making deliveries for the New Plague met sudden ends, which the writer calls simple apothecary accidents. The writer offers a mountain meeting place to discuss what happened.

faq.q: Where does the note tell you to go?
faq.answer: The writer directs you to a secluded refuge in the mountains between the Barrens and Desolace.

faq.q: What is the New Plague mentioned in the letter?
faq.answer: The New Plague is a deadly concoction developed in Undercity by the Forsaken's Royal Apothecary Society. It is meant to destroy both the Scourge and living enemies. Its testing and courier runs across the continents bring secrecy and fatal danger.

faq.q: Who wrote the note pinned to the plank?
aliases: who is waiting in the mountains
faq.answer: The note is anonymous and pinned to a rough wooden plank at a backcountry camp. Its writer offers a mountain meeting place between the Barrens and Desolace.

faq.q: Why would couriers for the Forsaken be in Kalimdor?
faq.answer: Forsaken apothecaries gather exotic venoms, spores, and reagents from Kalimdor's flora and fauna. They coordinate shipments through Horde outposts and wilderness routes.

faq.q: Why are backcountry camps used for notes like this?
faq.answer: The Barrens sprawls beyond major settlements and is loosely governed. Neutral waystations, mercenary rest spots, and rogue camps give travelers, smugglers, and informers a discreet place to leave word, away from the Horde and regional watch posts.

angles.text: For Forsaken travelers, a rogue mention of the Royal Apothecary Society and its blight research may be an urgent security matter, or a dangerous conspiracy from within.
As a Horde wanderer in the Barrens, you weigh whether reports of lethal plague deliveries on Kalimdor soil threaten your lands and alliances.
As a rogue, you know how to track anonymous informants and judge covert messages left between Desolace and the Barrens.
